## Research {#research .reveal}

My research is in **machine learning**, with a primary focus on
**Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks**, a neural network architecture that replaces
fixed activation functions on nodes with learnable activation functions on edges.

::: {.cards .reveal}
::: {.card-x}
[<i class="bi bi-speedometer2"></i>]{.card-icon}

### Optimization for KANs

Adaptive optimizer sequencing (L-BFGS first), validated with ablations
against baselines, with open-source code.
:::

::: {.card-x}
[<i class="bi bi-braces"></i>]{.card-icon}

### Interpretability

Turning trained KANs into readable mathematical formulas (Julia), so a model
can be inspected rather than just trusted.
:::

::: {.card-x}
[<i class="bi bi-bullseye"></i>]{.card-icon}

### Confidence & error estimation

Methods to estimate how confident a model is and how wrong it is likely to be,
including Hessian-based analysis.
:::
:::
